However, the conclusion claims Q → R, which is the converse of what we can derive.

The converse of an implication is not logically equivalent to the original implication. Just because R → Q doesn't mean Q → R.

- Premise 1 (P → Q): false → true = true ✓
- Premise 2 (R → P): false → false = true ✓
